name: Regulatory Changes
description: News related to new laws, regulations, government policies, or enforcement actions impacting the cryptocurrency market, including bans, approvals, taxation, and compliance requirements.

name: Technological Advancements
description: Headlines detailing breakthroughs in blockchain technology, new protocol developments, scalability solutions, upgrades (e.g., Ethereum's Merge), and innovations in smart contracts or decentralized applications (dApps).

name: Macroeconomic Factors
description: News concerning broader economic trends such as inflation rates, interest rate changes, monetary policy, currency devaluations, and global economic stability that could influence investor sentiment towards digital assets.

name: Institutional Adoption
description: Reports on major financial institutions, corporations, or governments investing in, adopting, or offering cryptocurrency-related services, products, or infrastructure.

name: Security Breaches & Exploits
description: News about hacks, theft of digital assets from exchanges or wallets, smart contract vulnerabilities, and other security incidents that undermine trust and confidence in the ecosystem.

name: New Project Launches & ICOs/IDOs
description: Announcements of new cryptocurrency projects, initial coin offerings (ICOs), initial DEX offerings (IDOs), or significant token generation events that introduce new supply or demand dynamics.

name: Market Sentiment & FUD/FOMO
description: Headlines reflecting prevailing market sentiment, including fear, uncertainty, and doubt (FUD) or fear of missing out (FOMO), often driven by social media trends, influencer opinions, or speculative news.

name: Partnerships & Collaborations
description: News detailing strategic alliances, joint ventures, or partnerships between cryptocurrency projects, companies, or different sectors that aim to expand utility or market reach.

name: Geopolitical Events
description: Significant global events such as wars, political instability, international sanctions, or major policy shifts in key countries that could affect risk appetite and capital flows into digital assets.

name: Neutral/Noise
description: Headlines that are tangentially related to the digital asset market or cryptocurrencies but have no discernible material impact on revenue growth or investor sentiment.
